semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in particle detection and analysis equipment crucial for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Tianjin Logan KX Technology Co., Ltd develops and manufactures advanced particle detection and analysis equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including the KT Series and KZ Series particle counters, are essential for defect detection and contamination monitoring in semiconductor fabrication, ensuring material and environmental integrity.
capabilities: KT Series particle counters for portable applications
KZ Series particle counters for inline applications
Oil contamination detection equipment (KT-2A and KT-2P models)
